items.title: Broadcast chat removal events for X Activity API
items.content_text: Today, we added the broadcast.chat.remove event to the X Activity API . Subscribe by User ID with the broadcast.read scope to be notified in real time when the host or a moderator removes a chat message from a broadcast the user owns. The payload carries the broadcast_id and the message_id of the removed message.

items.title: Migrate OAuth 1.0a user tokens to OAuth 2.0 with token exchange
items.content_text: Apps with existing OAuth 1.0a users can now exchange each user’s stored OAuth 1.0a access token and secret for an OAuth 2.0 access token and refresh token, with no consent screen or re-authorization. Send grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange to POST /2/oauth2/token ; the granted scopes are derived from the permissions the user originally authorized, and offline.access is always included.

items.title: safety\_identifier request field
items.content_text: You can now send safety identifier , an opaque end-user identifier assigned by your application, on Chat Completions, the Responses API, deferred chat completions, the Batch API, and the gRPC GetCompletionsRequest . It lets SpaceXAI attribute a policy violation to one of your end users rather than to your API key. The legacy user field is still accepted. See the Security FAQ.

items.title: Grok 4.7
items.content_text: Grok 4.7, SpaceXAI's frontier model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, is now available on the xAI API as grok-4.7 . It has a 500k context window, text and image inputs with text-only output, and no text output limit. Pricing is $2 / $0.50 / $6 per 1M tokens (input / cached input / output) below 200k prompt tokens, and $4 / $1 / $12 above. Reasoning effort supports low, medium, high (default), and xhigh. On the Responses API, grok-4.7 always returns reasoning.encrypted content , even

items.title: grok-imagine-image-quality retirement on November 2
items.content_text: On November 2, 2026, grok-imagine-image-quality is retired. Requests to the slug will be served by grok-imagine-image-2.0 with quality set to low , with no change to the request or response shape and at a lower per-image price. grok-imagine-image (1.0) is not affected. See the migration guide.

items.title: Media upload and Post-create size and duration limits
items.content_text: We documented the size and duration limits that apply when uploading media and when attaching it to a Post. Upload and POST /2/tweets are separately enforced. Limits follow the authenticated user’s X Premium / verified status and media_category , not your developer API plan.

items.title: Adjustable VAD threshold for Speech to Text
items.content_text: Speech to Text now accepts a vad threshold parameter (streaming query param and batch multipart field) to tune the voice-activity gate that skips non-speech audio. Lower values transcribe quieter or noisier speech — useful for narrowband telephony — and 0 disables the gate. See the Speech to Text docs.
